command: set -euo pipefail; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo LLAMA_CLI=$(command -v llama-cli || true); echo OLLAMA=$(command -v ollama || true); if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then ollama list 2>/dev/null || true; fi; echo PROJECT_FRANKENSTEIN; if [ -d "$HOME/Project-Frankenstein/.git" ]; then git -C "$HOME/Project-Frankenstein" rev-parse HEAD; git -C "$HOME/Project-Frankenstein" status --short; fi; echo KNOWN_MODEL_DIRS; for p in "$HOME/models" "$HOME/.cache/huggingface/hub" "$HOME/.cache/llama.cpp"; do if [ -d "$p" ]; then echo EXISTS:$p; ls -1 "$p" 2>/dev/null | head -30; fi; done
